used_by: build/expand_lsj.py --expand-verbs: principal parts and the entries the verb pass skips (prefixes, cross-references, person-limited verbs)
note: The LSJ9 glosses export the 1.3.26 expansion read (lsj9 commit f3c9fd0). A different export changes ag_lookup.json, so the verb pass refuses one that does not match.

principal_parts_supplement.note: The same file at lsj9 commit b72652a, saved under this name. The current export ends many verb entries' head text at the first citation, before the remaining principal parts; this export keeps them. The verb pass reads it only for tenses the current text does not give: 978 verb entries gain 3,018 principal parts.
